definitionOfGood: A readable bright blue90degree reef turn, with useful rounded/faceted rock volume and rooted teal/purple coral groups, soft neutral lighting, and clean exact finite-profile joins to the approved canonical middle at both ports in all4facings.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Improve the tall flat wall/black fascia and sparse peg effect into purposeful native rock terraces/shoulders and readable bent mass. Keep finite perimeter/functional contacts and handed ports. Source part counts and weak internal folds are not constraints.

Saturated blue/cyan rock, teal focal and purple supporting coral retain clear value/color separation with broad soft highlights. Recesses are local useful depth; no broad black band, gray mud, white sparkle or artificial silhouette halo. Canonical endpoint response joins coherently.

Both true local interfaces read as one continuous reef surface against exact approved middle under actual native and independent consumer all4 contexts. No cap/line/band/crack/step/fringe or true-interior alpha loss. Canonical field proof is necessary but does not replace visible assessment.

Coral openings/rims and chosen rock details enrich the turn without noise. Bases contact supporting native volume, holes have believable depth at logical128, and large color groups remain distinct at phone32; individual tiny openings need not survive phone size. Pink source accent can be retained as a restrained purposeful detail, without freezing source count or exact placement.

Every facing has coherent native volume and readable turn/coral hierarchy. No dead side, floating coral, exposed internal folds, coplanar flash, clipping, harsh normal discontinuity, black patch, directional shadow or unplanned overlap. The one-view image target does not invent unseen exact views.

evaluation.shapeVolume: Native sculptural hierarchy and functional turn identity, not literal target silhouette matching.
evaluation.color: Blue/teal/purple palette family and readable value groups.
evaluation.lightingHighlights: Broad softened form response under one symmetric rig.
evaluation.materialDetail: Purposeful dimensional coral/stone detail and rooted construction.
evaluation.artifactFreeReadability: All4actual intended-size/background contexts, including both port joins.
evaluation.scores: Comparative observations only; no universal approval threshold.

approvalRule: Only a future hash-bound candidate with complete native/profile/field/ownership/static/capture evidence and inspected actual images can be approved. Missing evidence → needs_evidence; preparation grants no derivative approval.
